clean_main_node_modules: run clean_main to remove the node_modules directory from the Mephisto repo root
clean_main_with_locks: run clean_main with remove_package_locks to also delete package-lock.json
clean_main_verbose: run clean_main with verbose mode to print cleanup status messages
review_clean_main: review the clean_main function that delegates to clean_main_node_modules for React app cleanup
refactor_clean_main: refactor clean_main to accept a custom repo path instead of the hardcoded REPO_PATH
